title: Iran rules out talks with the US until its seven conditions are met
caption:
Iran says it will not negotiate with the United States until seven conditions are met, including an end to the US naval blockade of its ports. Iran's navy says oil tankers hit mines in the Strait of Hormuz on Monday and Tuesday, with no casualties reported. Qatar says it is working with both sides to revive talks.

One story. Twice a day. Follow for the next edition.
